findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 32 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 169 questions numbered 1-169; by section: 32.1 27, 32.2 6, 32.3 29, 32.4 9, 32.5 18, 32.6 11, 32.7 12, 32.8 6, 32.9 6, 32.10 11, 32.11 4, 32.12 16, 32.13 9, 32.14 5. Keys: {'a': 42, 'b': 42, 'c': 43, 'd': 42}.

Covers every section 32.1-32.14 in order (therapeutic window and index, stomach pH, penicillin, opiates and opioid receptors, viral infections, fertilizers and plant nutrients, pesticides, acid rain, climate change, genetic engineering, raw materials, chemical industry and economy, industrial processes, applications, safety). TI values and acid-rain mole ratios were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀, penicillin mimics the enzyme's substrate, the protease inhibitor stops the cutting of the polyprotein, nickel as the eighth micronutrient, zinc phosphide is a rodenticide; the 13% nitrogen-fixation figure is not used. Fentanyl and strobilurins are not used in any option (see report).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
